cards.title: Should You Let AI Parent Your Kids?
cards.body: Tech companies now offer eye-movement trackers and 'optimized nap predictions' to help parents. But do families actually need AI to manage parenting basics?

cards.title: Skip the '18 Summers' Parenting Trend
cards.body: Turning summer into a structured 'making memories' exercise misses the point of childhood downtime. Long, unscheduled days are what kids actually need.

cards.title: Why Gifted Kids Are So Intense
cards.body: Gifted children often struggle with their own intensity and high expectations. Understanding their challenges is the first step to supporting them properly.

cards.title: Asynchronous Development in Bright Children
cards.body: Smart kids often develop unevenly—excelling in some areas while struggling in others. Parents need to pay closer attention to how their bright child navigates the world.

cards.title: Does Parental Chaos Create Psychopathy?
cards.body: Recent research links unpredictable parenting to specific traits of psychopathy, especially in boys. Early home instability may have lasting effects on child development.

cards.title: Stop Bankrolling Your Adult Child
cards.body: Every financial bailout sends a message to your adult child about responsibility. Constant rescues rarely help them become independent.
